content:
{'translation': '溫家寶、賈慶林等出席大會', 'original': '溫家寶、賈慶林等出席大會'}

{'translation': '紀念江澤民誕辰100周年大會，周一（17日）早上在北京人民大會堂舉行，中共中央總書記、國家主席、中央軍委主席習近平和現任政治局常委均有出席。溫家寶、賈慶林、張德江、俞正聲、栗戰書、汪洋、李嵐清、曾慶紅、李長春、賀國強、劉雲山、王岐山、張高麗等已退休領導人亦有出席大會。', 'original': "A grand gathering to commemorate the 100th birthday of Jiang Zemin was held Monday morning at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, with Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, China's president and chairman of the Central Military Commission, as well as the current Standing Committee of the Politburo, all in attendance. Retired leaders including Wen Jiabao, Jia Qinglin, Zhang Dejiang, Yu Zhengsheng, Li Zhanshu, Wang Yang, Li Lanqing, Zeng Qinghong, Li Changchun, He Guoqiang, Liu Yunshan, Wang Qishan and Zhang Gaoli also attended the event."}

{'translation': '胡錦濤未見身影\u3000李瑞環、吳官正和羅幹缺席', 'original': 'Hu Jintao was not seen; Li Ruihuan, Wu Guanzheng and Luo Gan absent'}

{'translation': '不過，接替江澤民出任中共中央總書記、國家主席和中央軍委主席的胡錦濤，在央視直播中未見身影。另外，曾在江澤民時代擔任政治局常委的李瑞環、吳官正和羅幹亦缺席今次大會。', 'original': "However, Hu Jintao, who succeeded Jiang Zemin as general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, president and chairman of the Central Military Commission, was not seen in the CCTV live broadcast. Separately, Li Ruihuan, Wu Guanzheng and Luo Gan – Politburo Standing Committee members during Jiang's era – were also absent from the event."}

{'translation': '「1989嚴重政治風波\u3000江堅決執行黨中央決策」', 'original': '"1989 serious political turmoil: Jiang resolutely implemented Party Central\'s decisions"'}

{'translation': '習近平在大會上發表重要講話，在回顧江澤民如何由上海市委書記成為中共第三代中央領導集體核心的過程時，特別提到：「1989年春夏之交，我國發生嚴重政治風波，江澤民同志堅決擁護和執行黨中央正確決策，有力維護了上海穩定。」', 'original': 'In an important speech at the gathering, Xi Jinping reviewed how Jiang Zemin rose from Shanghai\'s Party chief to the core of the CPC\'s third generation of central leadership collective, and specifically noted: "In the spring and summer of 1989, our country experienced a serious political disturbance. Comrade Jiang Zemin resolutely upheld and implemented the correct decisions of the Party Central Committee, and effectively maintained stability in Shanghai."'}

{'translation': '習近平又提到，要學習江澤民「堅定如磐的政治信仰」，形容他在面對20世紀80年代末、90年代初國際風雲變幻和國內發生嚴重政治風波的重大考驗時，毫不動搖地堅持經濟建設，並強調治國必先治黨、治黨務必從嚴等做法。', 'original': 'Xi also said there was a need to learn from Jiang\'s "rock-solid political faith", describing how, when confronted with major tests including the changing international landscape of the late 1980s and early 1990s and a serious political disturbance at home, he unswervingly persisted in economic development, and emphasised approaches such as "the Party must be governed before the country is governed, and governing the Party must be strict."'}

{'translation': '習近平又稱，要學習江澤民「深謀遠慮的戰略思維」，提及江澤民任內領導實現香港、澳門順利回歸，以及推動兩岸雙方達成體現一個中國原則的「九二共識」。', 'original': 'Xi also said to learn from Jiang\'s "farsighted strategic thinking", mentioning that during his tenure Jiang led the smooth return of Hong Kong and Macau, and pushed both sides of the Taiwan Strait to reach the "1992 Consensus" which embodies the one-China principle.'}

{'translation': '外界關注北京此時為江澤民百年誕辰舉行大型紀念活動，以及習近平講話所釋放的政治訊號。', 'original': "Outside observers are paying attention to why Beijing is holding a large-scale commemoration for Jiang Zemin's centenary at this time, and to the political signals sent by Xi's speech."}

{'translation': '獨立政治學者陳道銀表示，在已故領導人百年誕辰時舉辦大型紀念活動，是制度上的慣例。以往不少重要領導人，例如毛澤東和鄧小平等，均曾舉行大型百年誕辰紀念活動。江澤民作為中共第三代領導集體核心，其百年誕辰舉行大型紀念活動，是符合慣例和規格的做法。', 'original': "Independent political scholar Chen Daoyin said that holding a large commemoration for a late leader's centenary is an institutional convention. Many important leaders in the past, including Mao Zedong and Deng Xiaoping, have had large-scale centenary commemorations held for them. As the core of the CPC's third generation of central leadership collective, it is in line with convention and protocol for a major commemoration to be held for Jiang Zemin's centenary."}

{'translation': '學者：1989年說法並無新表述', 'original': 'Scholar: 1989 remarks contain no new formulations'}

{'translation': '對於習近平紀念江澤民時主動提到江澤民在1989年的政治取態，陳道銀認為，1989年是中國政治和江澤民政治生涯的重要轉折點。江澤民當年因「站對邊」，由原本快將退休的地方領導人臨危受命，調往北京取代趙紫陽，成為中共第三代中央領導集體核心，因此回顧其一生，必須提及1989年的事件。', 'original': 'On Xi Jinping taking the initiative to mention Jiang\'s political stance in 1989 while commemorating him, Chen Daoyin said 1989 was an important turning point for Chinese politics and Jiang\'s political career. Because Jiang had picked the "right side" that year, he was entrusted with a mission at a critical moment, going from a local leader on the verge of retirement to being transferred to Beijing to replace Zhao Ziyang, becoming the core of the third generation central leadership collective. Therefore, looking back at his life, the events of 1989 had to be mentioned.'}

{'translation': '陳道銀表示，江澤民當年堅決維護黨中央的決定，與習近平目前強調「兩個維護」的政治要求相呼應，因此更有重提的需要。他又認為，習近平有關1989年的說法，內容均是「蓋棺定論」的說法，並沒有提出新的表述，外界毋須因習近平重提1989年而作過度解讀。', 'original': 'Chen said Jiang\'s resolutely upholding the Party Central Committee\'s decision back then echoes Xi\'s current political requirement of emphasising the "two upholds", making the need to bring it up again greater. He also believes that Xi\'s remarks about 1989 are all "definitive" characterisations and offer no new formulations, and that outside observers should not overinterpret Xi\'s re-mentioning of 1989.'}

{'translation': '至於江澤民百年誕辰的大型紀念活動，作為中共第四代領導集體核心的胡錦濤缺席。陳道銀表示，雖然退休領導人不一定要出席相關活動，但紀念江澤民的大型活動，照理胡錦濤作為接替人，理應會出席。他未有現身，可能是不在北京或身體不適等原因。他指出，周二（18日）朱鎔基的告別式，可以留意胡錦濤有沒有送花牌。', 'original': "As for Hu Jintao, the core of the CPC's fourth generation central leadership collective, being absent from the grand commemoration of Jiang's centenary, Chen said that although retired leaders are not required to attend such events, as Jiang's successor Hu should logically have attended a major commemoration for Jiang. His absence could be because he was not in Beijing or was unwell, among other reasons. He pointed out that Tuesday's (18th) farewell ceremony for Zhu Rongji will be worth watching to see whether Hu sends a wreath."}

{'translation': '專門研究中國政治發展和兩岸關係的台灣文化大學社科院前院長趙建民認為，習近平今天的講話，是對江澤民一生作全面回顧。江澤民政治生涯的幾個重要關鍵，包括提出「三個代表」重要思想、兩岸達成「九二共識」，以及1989年堅決擁護黨中央的決定等，都是回顧江澤民時無法迴避的內容。', 'original': 'Zhao Jianmin, former dean of the College of Social Sciences at Chinese Culture University in Taiwan, who specialises in Chinese political development and cross-strait relations, said Xi\'s speech today is a comprehensive review of Jiang\'s life. Several key elements of Jiang\'s political career – including putting forward the important thought of the "Three Represents", the cross-strait reaching of the "1992 Consensus", and his resolute upholding of the Party Central Committee\'s decision in 1989 – are unavoidable when reviewing Jiang.'}

{'translation': '趙建民表示，習近平只談及江澤民在1989年堅決站在黨中央一方，沒有就六四事件作更多表述，是正常的處理。', 'original': 'Zhao said it is normal handling for Xi to only mention Jiang resolutely standing on the side of the Party Central Committee in 1989, without elaborating further on the June 4th incident.'}

{'translation': '趙建民又指出，習近平重視江澤民百年誕辰，也有其個人因素。他認為，習近平後來能獲提拔，由福建的領導人先後調任中國經濟大省浙江和上海擔任「一把手」，為他晉身最高領導層奠定基礎，江澤民在這個過程中起了重要而關鍵的作用。', 'original': "Zhao also noted that Xi's emphasis on Jiang's centenary has personal factors. He believes that Jiang played an important and crucial role in Xi's subsequent promotion, as Xi moved from a leader in Fujian to become the top leader of major economic provinces Zhejiang and Shanghai, laying the foundation for his ascent to the top leadership."}

{'translation': '他認為，習近平重視江澤民的紀念活動，一方面顯示習近平念舊和感恩；另一方面，習近平透過評價江澤民，強調其推動從嚴治黨和反腐敗工作，亦可顯示相關政策是繼承和延續江澤民時代的工作方向，是執行黨內已有共識的做法，有澄清坊間傳聞的作用。', 'original': "He believes that Xi's emphasis on commemorating Jiang on one hand shows Xi is sentimental and grateful, while on the other, by evaluating Jiang and highlighting his push for strict Party governance and anti-corruption, Xi's policies are shown to inherit and continue the work direction of the Jiang era, implementing approaches with existing consensus within the Party, which serves to dispel speculation in some quarters."}

{'translation': '要突顯大是大非時刻服從黨中央的重要', 'original': 'Need to highlight importance of obeying the Party Central Committee at critical moments of right and wrong'}

{'translation': '不過，資深中國政評人蔡慎坤則有不同看法。他形容，習近平公開提及江澤民在1989年「政治風波」期間的取態屬罕見，又指江澤民在世時，以至他去世後其家人都希望淡化，而非強調江澤民如何因六四事件而躍升至最高權力中心。', 'original': 'However, veteran China political commentator Cai Shenkun has a different view. He described Xi\'s public mention of Jiang\'s stance during the 1989 "political disturbance" as unusual, and pointed out that both Jiang himself in his lifetime and his family after his death have wanted to downplay, rather than emphasise, how Jiang rose to the centre of power because of the June 4th incident.'}

{'translation': '蔡慎坤認為，習近平今次特別重提這一點，是要突顯在大是大非的時刻，服從黨中央和保持政治忠誠的重要。', 'original': 'Cai believes Xi specifically brought this up this time to highlight the importance of obeying the Party Central Committee and maintaining political loyalty at moments of major right and wrong.'}

{'translation': '此外，蔡慎坤指出，中共第二十一次全國代表大會（簡稱「中共二十一大」）預計於明年秋天召開。他相信，習近平重視江澤民百年誕辰，以及表揚他堅決擁護黨中央的選擇等事跡，一方面可以強調自己與江澤民之間的政治傳承關係，強化其政治延續的認受性；另一方面亦可藉紀念江澤民，向黨員重申服從中央和政治忠誠的重要。', 'original': 'In addition, Cai pointed out that the 21st National Congress of the Communist Party of China (abbreviated as "the Party\'s 20th Congress") is expected to be held next autumn. He believes Xi\'s emphasis on Jiang\'s centenary and his praise for Jiang\'s resolute choice to uphold the Party Central Committee, on one hand emphasise the political succession relationship between himself and Jiang, strengthening the legitimacy of his political continuity; on the other hand, by commemorating Jiang, he can also reiterate to Party members the importance of obeying the Central Committee and political loyalty.'}
